# ADR-3058: A05: Prefer automated config drift detection for stack 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Silent drift reopens closed findings.

## Decision

Ops SHOULD prefer automated config drift detection for stack 10 (A05-10) where manual reviews miss changes.

## Consequences

Drift alerts page owning teams.
